# facadedriver

> Model-agnostic orchestration layer for multi-LLM production systems.
> Source: https://github.com/sailikhithk/facadedriver

FacadeDriver is a Python library that sits between your application code
and your LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and others),
handling the failure modes that single-provider demos don't cover:

- routing requests to per-route models from a YAML config
- swapping models at runtime with zero code changes
- retry with exponential backoff and jitter
- per-route fallback chains (if Gemini fails, try Claude, then GPT)
- per-model circuit breakers on error rate, hallucination rate, or p99 latency
- per-request telemetry (cost, latency, tokens, provider, model, route)
- pluggable backends (raw provider SDKs or litellm)
- pluggable telemetry sinks (structlog, Prometheus, Datadog, Loki)
- sync and async APIs with parity
- FastAPI server mode for centralizing LLM access across services
- CLI for ops (swap routes, list routes, replay requests)

## Install

```
pip install facadedriver[all]
```
